effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if you have an [Iliad] trait Digimon or Tamer, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Iliad] trait card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) for each of your Digimon.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your [Iliad] trait Digimon gain ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
